violations.text: Several items in the walk-in cooler were observed held beyond 7 days from the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation and held for no longer than 7 days unless frozen. Food items were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Covered Pans of food items prepped same day were observed cooling in the walk-in cooler at 62-74 degrees Fahrenheit (Covered with plastic wrap and foil). PIC uncovered/loosely covered food items to allow for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The wall mounted sanitizer mixer/dispenser was observed dispensing a mixture of sanitizer greater than 400 ppm. Wall mounted unit is to be adjusted to allow for proper sanitizer mix dispensing at 200-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 08/12/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 01/07/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the Quaternary Ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2025
The facility is lacking thermo-labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the high temp. dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the 3 Door Reach-In Freezer were observed to have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2025

At the time of inspection, the drain to the pre-flush sink in the counter prior to the dish machine, was observed to be leaking. Plumbing system is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2025
